limits: No new training, GPU generation or timings
Programs were not run using exec/eval; restricted numeric AST control is not official functional checker
Cached/full parity in returned notebook covers prefixes and short greedy16, not complete 1919 sequences
No GPU stage profiling; inferred batch padding slots do not quantify wall-time costs
Byte/BPE token loss is not comparable; BPE increases parameter count and output cap coverage
Some reference programs are incorrect or ambiguous; reference numeric equality is not mathematical truth
